purpose: Fixed three-scene closed-loop falsification diagnostic for the static N4 bank; not a candidate acceptance or threshold change.

scenes.selection_role: previously tested high-frequency W09 scene; independent N4 filter diagnostic
first T1 scene in highest nonzero TRAIN wind-frequency group

intervention.type: fixed causal 4-section unity-DC biquad notch cascade
intervention.application_point: final held C5 applied position compensation before force injection
intervention.event_update: only logged 100-Hz C5 position events; zero-order hold between events
intervention.state_initialization: initialize all sections at first nonzero action event and pass that sample unchanged

frequency_metrics: task-minus-actual roll/pitch/yaw band RMS and phase
command target band RMS and phase
filtered attitude reference band RMS and phase
frozen_scoring.phase_method: single-sided Hann cross-spectrum on the first 20,000 common 1-ms transitions; report circular phase difference target-to-actual at each exact TRAIN peak and notch center

predeclared_diagnostic_criteria.all_three_scenes: candidate Q_m <= 1.05 * same-scene C5 Q_m; stable 20,000-transition run; all safety counters zero
predeclared_diagnostic_criteria.failure_action: report failure and stop; do not auto-expand or tune

decision_language: Any measured pass/fail is restricted to these fixed TRAIN scenes and this one static N4 intervention. The 24-scene replay remains a mechanism-only result, including its low-frequency phase-risk flags.
